definitions.explanation: A formal gathering centered around drinking alcohol. More literary and formal than 飲み会, often used for traditional or historical banquets.

examples.japanese: {酒宴|しゅえん}を{催|もよお}す。
{結婚|けっこん}を{祝|いわ}って{酒宴|しゅえん}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A banquet was held to celebrate the marriage.

examples.japanese: {夜遅|よるおそ}くまで{酒宴|しゅえん}が{続|つづ}き、{翌朝|よくあさ}は{皆|みな}{二日酔|ふつかよ}いだった。
examples.english: The banquet went on until late at night, and the next morning everyone had a hangover.

notes:
A formal and somewhat literary word. In everyday conversation, {飲|の}み{会|かい} (drinking party) or {宴会|えんかい} (banquet) are more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒宴|しゅえん}を{催|もよお}す (to hold a banquet)
- {酒宴|しゅえん}を{開|ひら}く (to give a banquet)
- {酒宴|しゅえん}が{続|つづ}く (the feast continues)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宴会|えんかい} — general banquet (neutral register)
- {飲|の}み{会|かい} — casual drinking party (informal)
- {酒宴|しゅえん} — drinking feast (literary/formal)
